meta.purpose: move P7814 Decatur Lateral Project from Transco to Rockies Express (EIA August 2026, FERC CP25-94); owner Tallgrass Energy LP; length 16.7 mi, capacity 181.4 MMcf/d

verifications.note: The EIA pipeline projects list for August 2026 has the Decatur Lateral Project under Rockies Express Pipeline LLC: approved, Illinois, 16.7 miles, 20 inch, 181.4 million cubic feet a day, in service 2027.
A Federal Register notice from 15 May 2025 on FERC docket CP25-94-000 names Rockies Express Pipeline LLC as the company proposing the Decatur Lateral Project in Macon County, Illinois.
The FERC scoping and site review page for the proposed Decatur Lateral Project names Rockies Express Pipeline LLC as the applicant.

resolutions.researcher_notes: EIA's July 2025 pipeline projects list put the Decatur Lateral Project under Transco, and the sheet followed it. The project actually belongs to Rockies Express Pipeline LLC. Rockies Express filed it with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) on 28 February 2025 under docket CP25-94-000. EIA has listed it under Rockies Express since October 2025, and its August 2026 list still does. This moves the row under the Rockies Express Gas Pipeline, matching the other Rockies Express rows, which leave the network grouping blank. The old values were Transcontinental Gas Pipeline in the grouping and name columns and the Transco wiki page.

resolutions.researcher_notes: EIA's July 2025 pipeline projects list put the Decatur Lateral Project under Transco, and the sheet followed it. The project actually belongs to Rockies Express Pipeline LLC. Rockies Express filed it with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) on 28 February 2025 under docket CP25-94-000. EIA has listed it under Rockies Express since October 2025, and its August 2026 list still does. The old operator was Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Co LLC.

verifications.note: The EIA pipeline projects list for August 2026 has the Decatur Lateral Project under Rockies Express Pipeline LLC.
Phillips 66's annual report for 2025 says it sold its 25 percent ownership interest in Rockies Express Pipeline LLC on 14 June 2024.
An NS Energy story from June 2024 says Phillips 66 sold its 25 percent stake in Rockies Express to a Tallgrass Energy subsidiary.
Vinson and Elkins, counsel on the deal, says Tallgrass Energy will own 100 percent of the common equity in Rockies Express after the sale. Not cited, because it repeats the Phillips 66 announcement.

resolutions.researcher_notes: The Decatur Lateral Project is being built by Rockies Express Pipeline LLC, so it takes the owner of Rockies Express. Tallgrass Energy LP owns all of Rockies Express. Phillips 66 held the other 25 percent until it sold that stake to a Tallgrass subsidiary on 14 June 2024, as its annual report for 2025 says. The other Rockies Express rows still show Tallgrass Energy at 75 percent and Phillips 66 at 25 percent, which was true before the sale. The old owner here was Transco at 100 percent.

verifications.note: The EIA pipeline projects list for August 2026 gives the Decatur Lateral Project a length of 16.7 miles.
A Federal Register notice from 15 May 2025 describes a 15.9 mile lateral and a 0.8 mile spur, 16.7 miles in all.

resolutions.researcher_notes: The sheet had 16 miles. EIA's August 2026 list gives 16.7 miles. A Federal Register notice from May 2025 describes a 15.9 mile lateral plus a 0.8 mile spur to the ADM plant, which is also 16.7 miles. The old value was 16.00 miles.

verifications.note: The EIA pipeline projects list for August 2026 gives the Decatur Lateral Project a capacity of 181.4 million cubic feet a day.

resolutions.researcher_notes: The sheet had 181 million cubic feet a day, a rounded figure. EIA's August 2026 list gives 181.4. A Rockies Express amendment filed in October 2025 raised the requested service to 194,400 dekatherms a day, but EIA has not picked that up, so the EIA figure is used. The old value was 181.00.
